name: session-limits
title: Session Limits
description: Track Codex and Claude Code usage limits, remaining quotas, and reset times in Raycast and your menu bar.
author: vedant_kalipatnapu

commands.name: session-limits
commands.title: Show Session Limits
commands.description: Check usage quotas and reset times for your coding assistants.

commands.name: limits-menu-bar
commands.title: Session Limits Menu Bar
commands.description: Keep your remaining coding assistant quotas in the menu bar.

preferences.name: enableCodex
preferences.title: Providers
preferences.label: Codex
preferences.description: Read quota limits using your existing Codex sign-in.

preferences.name: enableClaude
preferences.label: Claude Code
preferences.description: Read quota snapshots from Claude Code through a one-time local status-line connection.

preferences.name: codexHome
preferences.title: Codex Home
preferences.description: Optional Codex account directory. Defaults to CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex.

preferences.name: claudeConfigDir
preferences.title: Claude Config Directory
preferences.description: Optional Claude profile directory containing settings.json. Defaults to CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude.

preferences.name: customProviderFile
preferences.title: Custom Providers
preferences.description: Optional local JSON file with quota snapshots for any other provider. See the README for the format.

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
